original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚国防部长悼念军机坠毁遇难者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国防部长克里斯托弗·穆萨就一架尾号NAF 931的军用飞机坠毁发表声明，表示深切哀悼。据其称，事故造成正在执行例行飞行任务的军官和空军士兵丧生，机上还有平民。穆萨表示已下令对坠机原因展开全面调查，并加强军事航空安全规程。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚国防部长克里斯托弗·穆萨就一架尾号NAF 931的军用飞机坠毁表示深切哀悼
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Minister of Defence, Gen. Christopher Musa, has expressed deep sorrow over the crash of a military aircraft with tail number NAF 931 involving personnel of the Armed Forces.

key_facts.fact: 据穆萨称，事故造成执行例行飞行任务的军官和空军士兵丧生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident claimed the lives of officers and airmen who were on routine flight mission while serving the nation

key_facts.fact: 穆萨还向机上平民家属表示哀悼
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The minister also condoled with families of civilians on board the ill-fated aircraft.

key_facts.fact: 已下令对坠机原因展开全面调查并加强军事航空安全规程
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a comprehensive investigation into the circumstances surrounding the crash had been ordered to ascertain the cause and ensure reinforcement of operational safety protocols across military aviation units

uncertainties: 坠机原因尚未查明，有待调查
伤亡人数未在报道中明确
该事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
